title: GPT-6 brings interactive answers to more ChatGPT users
friendlyTitle: ChatGPT can now build interactive answers
summary: OpenAI is rolling GPT-6 out across paid and free ChatGPT tiers with Intelligent UI, which can compose answers using charts, forms, buttons and interactive diagrams as well as text. Paid tiers use GPT-6 Sol, while Free and Go users receive GPT-6 Luna.
friendlySummary: GPT-6 can answer with useful controls, charts and simple tools instead of only text. The update is coming to both paid and free ChatGPT users.
whyItMatters: The useful unit of an AI response is moving beyond a block of prose toward a small interface built for the immediate task. That can reduce the work of turning an answer into a plan, comparison or simple tool, while making interface accuracy another thing users must check.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Some tasks may become easier because you can use the answer directly. You should still check the facts and the controls it creates.
